subject.title: fix(codex): require explicit final source delivery

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` completion use an explicit model-facing `final` parameter, or retain implicit terminal sends with stronger final-only prompt steering?
rationale: Both implementations are technically viable, but they establish different durable compatibility and reliability guarantees that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Explicit final contract
options.body: Structurally prevent progress sends from terminating, while requiring completed source replies to supply `final=true`.

options.title: Prompt-only contract
options.body: Preserve implicit receipt-based completion and rely on stronger instructions to keep progress sends out of the terminal message path.

recommendation.title: Explicit final contract
recommendation.body: Structurally prevent progress sends from terminating, while requiring completed source replies to supply `final=true`.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Codex runtime behavior and shared source-delivery semantics, and steipete has recent authored, reviewed, and integrated history across both surfaces.
